Theralion reset/engage/evade/death, heroic shift, airborne Twilight Blast and three Dazzling passes, landing handoff, grounded Fabulous/Engulfing events, and 10-minute berserk are implemented.

Valiona reset/engage/evade/death, heroic shift, grounded Blackout/Devouring events, airborne Meteorite, three-pass Deep Breath movement, lane randomization, landing handoff, and berserk are implemented.
Unstable Twilight movement/detonation and Twilight Sentry/Rift summon/death cleanup are implemented; periodic spell durations are not in C++.
Dazzling normal/Twilight realm filters, Fabulous random target filter, Engulfing target filter and 10/25-player cap, and output-based Engulfing proc are implemented.
Blackout random target/removal/split, distance-scaled Devouring Flames, and Twilight Meteorite target exclusions and split are implemented.

Deep-breath lane targeting, portal/sentry periodic summon hooks, Twilight Flames filters, phase-shift stack transition, spell-click return, Shifting Reality, and portal scale handling are implemented.
Map 671 encounter IDs, boss/support creature entries, door entries, phase-related data IDs, and generic Berserk spell are registered.
Instance maps boss/support creatures, forwards summons, tracks Valiona dummy/portal/Unstable GUIDs, handles FAIL/DONE cleanup, and reports portal counts.
The dedicated Theralion/Valiona script and Bastion instance script are declared and registered with the Eastern Kingdoms loader.
The 4.3.4-era snapshot has level-88 boss identities and ScriptNames but base health fields only; it does not establish 4.4.2 four-mode tuning.

lifecycle.engage: Valiona starts ground events (Blackout10.5s, Devouring25s); Theralion calls liftoff, flies to target, and starts Dazzling after1m22s. Both send encounter-frame engage; heroic applies Twilight Shift and Valiona's dummy auras.
lifecycle.valiona_ground: Blackout and Devouring are scheduled; Theralion air Twilight Blast runs until Dazzling begins.
lifecycle.theralion_ground: After landing movement, attack resumes after2s; Fabulous begins after3.6s and Engulfing after12s; Valiona air Meteorite runs until Deep Breath.
lifecycle.transitions: Theralion fires three Dazzling passes then lands while Valiona liftoffs. Valiona performs three randomized lane passes then lands while Theralion liftoffs.
lifecycle.twilight_realm: Dazzling/Twilight Flames phase filters and portal spell-click provide entry/exit; Unstable Twilight movement/detonation and heroic Sentry/Rift are locally registered.
lifecycle.evade: Each boss disengages, restores gravity, despawns its summons, and calls _DespawnAtEvade; instance FAIL delays Valiona dummy/Unstable cleanup by30s and clears selected GUID sets.
lifecycle.death: Ground-phase death casts the sibling instakill (95741/95742), then generic _JustDied and encounter disengage; instance DONE despawns dummy/Unstable and schedules Cho'gall response after6s.
lifecycle.retail_credit_status: Repository boss-state and progression path audited; retail lockout, loot, achievement, and reset persistence unresolved.
